channels.name: Falling diagonal \
channels.desc: Peaks on a \ stroke and goes almost silent on / .

channels.name: Upright stroke |
channels.desc: Prefers vertical strokes; nearly silent on flat ones.

channels.name: Steep rising /
channels.desc: Prefers / strokes between 45° and vertical; silent on a shallow \ .

channels.name: Flat or gently rising
channels.desc: Likes flat and shallow / strokes, so it lights up along the bottoms of boxes and triangles.

channels.name: Anything but upright
channels.desc: Responds to flats and both diagonals, and drops out on near-vertical strokes. Busiest at the centre of an X.

channels.name: Flat stroke, underside
channels.desc: Ink above and blank below: the underside of flat or falling strokes. Silent on a 60° / .

channels.name: Upright stroke |, again
channels.desc: A second vertical detector with slightly different weights. Small networks often learn near-duplicates.

channels.name: Flat stroke, centred
channels.desc: Weights along its middle row: flat strokes and the tops of corners like ┐.

channels.name: Corner ┐
channels.desc: A flat stroke turning down at the right: top-right corners of boxes, and plus crossings.

channels.name: Arch ∩
channels.desc: The top of a curve: a stroke rising and falling again.

channels.name: Falling arc
channels.desc: A \ stroke that bends as it goes, from circles and slanted sides.

channels.name: Bulging side )
channels.desc: A stroke curving round on the right, the side of a ring.

channels.name: Diagonal junctions
channels.desc: Places where diagonals cross or end: X centres, triangle corners.

channels.name: Peak ∧
channels.desc: Two strokes meeting at a point above, like a triangle's apex.

channels.name: Upright with crossbar
channels.desc: A vertical stroke, often with a flat one crossing it.

channels.name: Upswing ╯
channels.desc: A stroke curving upward to the right, the lower right of a ring.

channels.name: Corner ┐, sharp
channels.desc: A crisp right-angle turn from flat to downward.

channels.name: Diagonal crossing ╳
channels.desc: A / and a \ crossing: the middle of an X.

channels.name: Inner corner ┘
channels.desc: A short upright meeting a flat stroke, seen from the inside of a bend.

channels.name: Left bend (
channels.desc: A stroke curving round on the left, or a └ corner.

channels.name: X arm, upper right
channels.desc: The upper end of a falling diagonal arm, as found in an X.

channels.name: Long falling diagonal
channels.desc: A long \ stroke: the arm of an X or the right side of a triangle.

channels.name: Low curve ‿
channels.desc: A shallow curve near the bottom: the base of a ring or a rounded corner.

channels.name: Whole triangle △
channels.desc: Its 18×18 window holds most of a triangle: slanted sides meeting a base.

channels.name: Corner └
channels.desc: A bottom-left right angle: an upright meeting a flat base.

channels.name: Left corner or crossing
channels.desc: An upright and a flat stroke meeting on the left, or two diagonals crossing.

channels.name: Plus crossing ┼
channels.desc: A short upright and flat stroke crossing at right angles.

channels.name: Closed right side ⊐
channels.desc: A stroke that turns down and back on the right: a box's or a ring's right side.

channels.name: X arm, top
channels.desc: The top of a falling diagonal, close to the edge of the drawing.

channels.name: Slanted side meets base
channels.desc: A diagonal ending on a flat stroke, the bottom-right of a triangle.

channels.name: Crossbar ┬
channels.desc: A flat stroke with an upright through or below its middle.

channels.name: Arch ∩
channels.desc: A curving top, from rings, or the top half of an X.

channels.name: Whole X
channels.desc: Two long diagonals crossing near the middle. Almost only fires for crosses.

channels.name: Box top ┌┐
channels.desc: A flat top with an upright dropping from it: the top of a square.

channels.name: Short upright tick
channels.desc: A short vertical stroke near the top: a plus's upper arm.

channels.name: Falling diagonal, lower
channels.desc: The lower part of a \ stroke, from crosses and triangles.
